messages:
Irene C.: Quick follow-up from the hosting-mode handshake RFC: we discovered a couple of practical mismatches between routing decisions and SLA/telemetry labels during a dry-run. Need to align.
Leo H.: Can you give a concrete case?
Irene C.: Sure. In Private we observed adapters marking a capability failure (e.g., `kv_cache_miss_v3`) and routing to Hosted. The routing event contains the hosting mode, but our billing/alerts pipeline only saw the capability name and lost the original hosting context.
Maya R.: Oof. So charge/alert goes to Hosted even though the tenant is Private. Not good.
Irene C.: Exactly. Two proposals to fix: 1) make adapters emit a tiny probe envelope that includes `hosting_mode` and an opaque `tenant_hint`, 2) ensure control-plane normalizes the hint to a tenant id only in environments allowed to see it.
Leo H.: I like the envelope idea. Minimal payload so legacy adapters don't break. What keys?
Irene C.: Minimal set: `capability_id`, `probe_version`, `hosting_mode`, `tenant_hint`, `fallback_reason`. `tenant_hint` must be opaque (no raw tenant ids).
Maya R.: Important: Private adapters may be air-gapped. They can't call control-plane to resolve hints. We should ship a small `probe_hints_table` with the Private bundle so adapters can locally map hints to local tenant metadata for routing/metrics.
Omar T.: Agree. Implementation note: that table must not contain secrets (no KMS ARNs). Just mapping_key -> local_label. Control plane keeps the global mapping when available.
Leo H.: For observability, add `probe_layer` (adapter|controlplane) and `probe_normalization_version`. That'll let us correlate mismatches.
Maya R.: Add `handshake_status` semantic too: `ok|degraded|mismatched`. If mismatch, adapters should enter degraded behavior and flag events.
Irene C.: Behaviour on mismatch: do not silently fail. Options: refuse connection (hard-fail) or operate with `grace_period_seconds`. Proposal: default to grace period with a high severity alert.
Leo H.: Sounds safe. We also need a `reason` enum for fallback: `capacity`, `capability_mismatch`, `authz`, `latency_spike`. Downstream billing can use that for pricing decisions.
Maya R.: Deduping is necessary: each request has `request_id`. Ensure the billing pipeline dedupes fallback events by `request_id` and only applies a single charge decision per-request. Document that contract.
Omar T.: Security: the `tenant_hint` should be pseudorandom (HMAC of tenant id with a deployment-bound secret) so the control plane can reverse with the right key but logs don't leak identifiers. Private bundles can keep their HMAC key local; hosted control plane gets its mapping via customer onboarding.
Irene C.: Good call. Add `hint_ttl_seconds` with default 86400 so stale hints don't linger. Control plane can override per-tenant.
Leo H.: For rollout: adapters emit a baseline envelope (v1) that contains `hosting_mode` but no hint. v2 adds `tenant_hint` and `probe_normalization_version`. Feature-flag the v2 enrichment in control plane; slow rollout 10/50/100%.
Maya R.: Testing plan: create integration test where Private adapter emits envelope, control plane ingests, mapping resolves to tenant, and billing tags reflect the original hosting mode after fallback. Also test air-gapped path where adapter uses shipped `probe_hints_table`.
DevBot: CI: probe-enrichment branch build started by @Leo H. (build #2981)
Omar T.: Ops checklist: add an alert rule on `handshake_status==mismatched` with owners set to eng-runtime + infra. Also dashboard tile showing fallback count by `fallback_reason` and `prev_mode->next_mode`.
Irene C.: I'm updating the hosting-mode handshake RFC with these fields and the adapter manifest changes (`probe_normalization_version`, optional `probe_hints_table`, `grace_period_seconds`). Will include a short compatibility matrix.
Leo H.: I'll draft the schema snippet and add the dedupe contract for billing.
Maya R.: I'll own the integration tests and the telemetry side.
Irene C.: Thanks all. Plan: PR for schema + manifest changes today, stage next week.
